notes.title: Senza titolo
notes.content:
Hi Guys,

First of all we want to thank you, the first people crazy enough to believe in our project.

We are excited and proud to finally annouce that after many efforts ARK-ADE Playtest is now available for download!

You already helped a great deal with your suggestions during the last weeks, you were great and we can't find words to thank you, but now the going gets tough and we want you to play!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40618385/b244b6b5fd68fc5dd3808d4f7d7db02d4a2916cc.jpg[/img]

Please help us spot any bug, try all paths and shoot at anything you see...
Show no mercy, be ruthless and let us listen to all your suggestions. We need as many feedbacks as possible to let you get the best final version of the game we can provide!

And if you like it don't forget to share the Playtest with your friends, it will help us a lot.

Join our Discord Channel, link here[url=https://discord.gg/mK99nRNY4M]here[/url], this is where you can find us to share your thought about the game, to give us your feedbacks and, why not, just to have a little chat.
